changes.before: Your result is saved for the program owner and authorized program support. It is recorded as your account of the work.
changes.after: Your submitted result is kept as your record of the situation. Program owners and authorized program support can review it to understand your experience and follow up if needed.
changes.reason: Revised to clarify why saving the report matters, who uses it, and the purpose for recordkeeping and possible follow-up.

changes.before: Share a practical change, what you noticed, and what could happen next. Please leave out names, case details, and confidential information.
changes.after: Describe a practical change you made, what you observed, and what you think should happen next. Do not include names, case numbers, or other confidential details.
changes.reason: Expanded with clearer instruction and reasoning, specifying to describe the change, observation, and recommendation, and clarified exclusion of confidential information.

findings.finding: The proposed replacement changes the source meaning and conditions: The source states, 'Your result is saved for the program owner and authorized program support. It is recorded as your account of the work.' The rewrite suggests a different emphasis ('kept as your record of the situation...to understand your experience and follow up if needed'). This alters scope (from a program record of a work account to the respondent's 'record of the situation'), modifies purpose (from an official program record to focusing on respondent experience), and introduces a follow-up mechanism not present in the source. The source text must be preserved as an official record of what is conveyed to users.

The rewrite clarifies and expands the instruction with more direct language and explicit prohibitions ('Do not include names, case numbers, or other confidential details'). This is supportable from the source, which instructs users not to include confidential information. The intent is preserved, and the expansion adds practical clarity.
